newsitem.title: USA: SpeedFam Intl sets 3.0 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: SpeedFam Intl sets 3.0 mln shr offer.

text.p: SpeedFam International Inc on Thursday said it has priced a 3.0 million share common stock offer at $32.875 per share.
Of the 3.0 million common shares, 2.05 million are being sold by the company and the remainder by certain existing shareholders.
Lehman Brothers, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Needham & Co are acting as managing underwriters for the offering.
The Company designs, develops, manufactures, markets and services chemical mechanical polishing, or CMP systems used in the fabrication of semiconductor devices.
